AdminVisit.description: Minimum necessary: public IDs, no names, no transcripts, no clinical free text.
AdminVisit.title: AdminVisit

AgentSpeech.description: Agent utterance: text plus base64 WAV from Timbre (audio absent if TTS failed).
AgentSpeech.title: AgentSpeech

HouseholdPin.description: Map-safe summary: location and counts only (no programmes, no conditions).
HouseholdPin.title: HouseholdPin

NearbyHousehold.description:
A map pin plus its server-computed distance from the query point (metres, geography).
A suggestion only: being near a pin never selects or confirms that household.
NearbyHousehold.title: NearbyHousehold

PlaybackCompleted.description: The browser finished playing an agent clip. For a read-back it names the version read.
PlaybackCompleted.title: PlaybackCompleted

ReadbackRequest.description: Ask for the read-back of the current version again (e.g. after a TTS failure).
ReadbackRequest.title: ReadbackRequest

territory_id.description: Territory the worker moves to; the current assignment ends

RecordConfirm.description: Tap fallback for confirmation; must name the version that was read back.
RecordConfirm.title: RecordConfirm

SavedVisit.description: A confirmed visit as persisted. No transcripts or audio are stored.
SavedVisit.title: SavedVisit

SessionEnded.description: V2: the session stopped without saving (revoked, superseded, expired or cancelled).
SessionEnded.title: SessionEnded

V2SessionBound.description: V2: the server-verified, immutable subject of this voice session (display fields only).
V2SessionBound.title: V2SessionBound

V2SessionStart.description:
First frame of a V2 voice visit. IDs come from the explicit Phase 4 selection and are
re-authorised by the server; visit_type is the worker's explicit choice (may be unknown).
V2SessionStart.title: V2SessionStart

V2VisitSaved.description: V2: the one confirmed visit for this logical visit key (repeat confirms replay it).
V2VisitSaved.title: V2VisitSaved

VisitRecord.description: The in-progress or confirmed visit record shared by backend and frontend.
VisitRecord.title: VisitRecord

description: Root container so one schema file holds every shared type.
title: AshaSaathiContracts
